free_tier.stated: 8 points a day, where 'each point buys 2 hours of the advanced GPU V100 16GB or 1 hour of the advanced GPU V100 32GB', so the daily allowance is 8 hours on a V100 32GB or 16 hours on a V100 16GB; the same documentation caps the advanced GPU at 48 hours a week at bronze level

retention.stated: the daily window is somewhere between 2.6 and 8 hours and the container is destroyed rather than paused, so a checkpoint outside the persistent mount is lost each day; the Chinese real-name requirement is the harder wall.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: A V100 32 GB is the only free card found that can hold a 13B model unquantised, and as a chain element it is the training half and never the serving half.

limits.value: 48 hours a week of advanced-edition GPU and 4 hours a week of premium-edition GPU at the lowest level (power value 0 to 50), rising to 168 and 48 hours a week at the top level; 48 hours a week is below the 56 hours a week that 8 hours a day would allow

the container keeps running for 10 minutes after the browser is closed and is then terminated, and billing stops when that timer ends; stopping the project by hand from the project list reclaims it sooner

limits_note: the daily window is somewhere between 2.6 and 8 hours and the container is destroyed rather than paused, so a checkpoint outside the persistent mount is lost each day; the Chinese real-name requirement is the harder wall.
binding_note: the weekly cap of 48 hours at bronze level binds before the daily allowance: 8 hours a day is 56 hours a week, which the weekly cap refuses

identity_cost.detail: a Baidu account. The registration form asks for a username, a phone number chosen from a country selector that lists mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, the United States and others, a password and a captcha, and asks for no identity document. The help-site FAQ says the verification SMS reaches Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan and countries and regions outside the mainland, and that a number is entered as a plus sign and the country code followed by the number, so a non-mainland number can receive it. Whether starting a GPU notebook then requires an ID-document real-name step is unverified: behind a sign-up; the real-name page answers 'This operation requires login', no first-party page read states an ID document, AI Studio's model-creation page requires 完善身份信息 (completing identity information), and a third-party review reports a real-name step binding a phone number and an ID card before a GPU environment can start, so the kind rests on that report.

evidence.proved: quoted, translated from the vendor help page: 'each point buys 2 hours of the advanced GPU V100 16GB or 1 hour of the advanced GPU V100 32GB', and 'running a project each day grants 8 points', so the published daily allowance is 8 hours on a V100 32GB, which is the top of the stored 2.6-to-8-hour range and not the bottom; the same page states the environment 'keeps running for 10 minutes' after the browser closes and 'after 10 minutes it will be terminated', which supports the destroyed-not-paused claim. Supports the quota and the retention; the real-name gate is not on this page and stays reported
